expectations.name: autofix-bulk-applies-errata
expected_behavior: Acts on nothing outside the `## Errata` block: no mechanical issue absent from it is fixed, and the SRD is not re-scanned for new ones

Runs neither the glossary resolution nor the approval gate — errata touch neither ids nor terms — so no approval-gate `Status` line and no glossary question reach the user, and no `glossary_terms` call is made; the closing manifest's Status follow-up is not a gate line
Lists the three substitutions and takes one confirmation for the whole batch, not the per-change loop
Verifies each `old` at its anchor, applies the two that match exactly once, and reports the third as stale rather than guessing where it belongs
Writes no review file and invokes no `review` run; prints the exact hand-off command `review specs/login.md check #n #n`, scoped to the two applied errata, for the user to run
Closes with a manifest naming what was applied, what was skipped and why, and the findings handed to `check` — not what `check` later did with them

expectations.name: corpus-grounded-edit-routes-the-unconfirmable
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before accepting the edit, and the draft gap it hands over names the queries tried
Captures the gap with `srd:report-doc-gap` as a draft silently — no interruption and no grilling mid-edit
States the retry count as a fact inside the proposal, so the user's `YN` attests it and `srd:kb` receives it — the fact is in front of the user when the key is pressed, not looked up afterwards
Hands the unconfirmable claim to `srd:report-doc-gap` and the attested fact to `srd:kb`, and neither interrupts the edit in progress

expectations.name: feedback-without-a-review-file
expected_behavior: Says the review file is absent and stops: `#n` names a finding only a review file can carry
Invents no findings and proposes no edit of its own, even though the SRD has real defects
Leaves `specs/login.md` unchanged and writes no decision log
Says it in one or two lines naming the missing file, and reports nothing about its own start — no approval-gate line, no draft-check result, no closing manifest
Offers no menu of other ways in (run `review`, paste findings, drop the argument): the user asked for a finding number, and the answer is that there are none
